description: Defines the ObservationBuffer class for storing and processing network quality observations, including methods for adding observations, computing percentiles, and managing observation weights based on time and signal strength.

classes.name: ObservationBuffer
classes.description: A class that stores network quality observations, provides utility functions for statistical analysis, and manages observation weights based on time and signal strength.

methods.name: AddObservation
methods.description: Adds a new observation to the buffer, evicting the oldest if full.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of observations in the buffer.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all observations from the buffer.

methods.name: GetPercentile
methods.description: Calculates and returns the specified percentile of observations made on or after a given timestamp.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom tick clock for testing purposes.
